motion.name: ease-strike
motion.purpose: The strike and the 700ms image hover scale.

motion.name: strike
motion.value: @keyframes strike { from { transform: scale(1.045); filter: blur(6px) } to { transform: scale(1); filter: blur(0) } }
motion.purpose: The one authored motion; never starts from opacity 0.

motion.name: strike-on-load
motion.purpose: Opening image of a page only (home hero render, family and type hero images); animation: none under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: strike-on-view
motion.value: strike linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 10% cover 45%
motion.purpose: The embossed plate in the home made-to-mark band only; gated on @supports (animation-timeline: view()); none under reduced motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Pill colour, shadow and transform feedback; chevron nudge; products panel chevron rotation.

motion.name: image-hover
motion.purpose: Product, type and journal images on hover; family card cut-outs scale 1.04 and strip thumbnails 1.06 over 500ms.

imagery.studioRenders: public/assets/home/*.webp, each with a .webp.json sidecar {prompt, createdAt} recording origin and every grade or crop. Home hero is art-directed: portrait render below 768px, landscape from 768px with left and top mask fades.
imagery.cutOuts: public/assets/bento/*.webp transparent (small thumbnails in public/assets/bento/thumb for the family strip and products panel), served unoptimized, object-contain, grounding shadow. Last fallback for every catalog image spot, including placeholder product photos.
imagery.catalogPhotos: Sanity images: square in product cards, 4:3 or 16:9 in type and Get to know cards and the type hero, 4:3 in the detail gallery; journal 16:10.
imagery.clientMarks: Greyscale, 75% opacity, multiply blend, per-mark optical height, four-column grid on phones and one justified row from lg, no boxes.
imagery.leadSpots: Type cards, type heroes and Get to know cards use studio renders, cut-outs, Sanity images set on that type or card, or catalog photos on the LEAD_PHOTOS allowlist (data/families.ts) at least 1000px wide. Client-marked catalog photos stay in the style grids.

narrative.overview:
Metro Metal's catalog reads like a well-kept trade site: a normal white navbar that names every section, a contact bar above it, and pages that show everything at once in plain grids. The hardware is still the subject. Photographs and cut-out renders sit in soft aluminium wells, copy is short, and type is modest, so a buyer on a phone can take in the whole product range without scrolling sideways or decoding an unusual layout. The ground is gallery white and aluminium grey in full-width bands, closed by one near-black die band where objects are lit from above.

The world's ritual is still the die coming down on the mark. It shows up in two places: the strike motion (an opening image settling from slightly large and soft to exact and sharp) and the pressed state of every pill (a 1px deboss). Focus is the die edge, a 2px ink ring offset 3px. The current item in a wayfinding row (the nav, the family strip, the menu) reads in full ink against graphite neighbours; nothing is filled to show selection.

Density is moderate and mobile-first. Sections sit 40px apart on phones and 64px on desktop, cards sit 12 to 16px apart, and touch targets are at least 40px. Icons appear where they speed up scanning: contact routes, trust promises, process steps and the attachment hint. The one accent, plum, is spent on the quote action and on text links.
keyCharacteristics: White and aluminium bands, one die-black band per page.
Geist throughout: a modest mobile-first ramp (display 30 to 40px, body 16px) and one 15px/500 size for every control.
Everything in view: grids wrap, nothing scrolls sideways.
Pills for actions, plum "Label ›" links for navigation, 40px minimum tap height.
Borderless rounded aluminium cards, no strokes and no card shadows.
Outline icons beside contact routes, promises and steps, never on product cards or headings.
One authored motion, the strike, always visible from the first frame and removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Plum fills only the quote action and colours only text links. No plum backgrounds, borders, icons or headings. On the die band the quote pill turns light, so plum never sits on black.

rules.name: The One Die Rule
rules.body: A page gets at most one die-black band, and it carries a lit object. Every element inside it sits under `.on-die`, so the focus ring flips to Die Light.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small label sits above a heading. No kicker, no overline, no uppercase tracked tag, and no "01". The heading carries the weight, and context goes in the lede below it.

rules.name: The Scale-Utility Rule
rules.body: Headings use the display, headline, title and lede utilities; small text uses `text-sm` and `text-meta`. A new one-off size or clamp is a defect, not a new step.

rules.name: The One Control Size Rule
rules.body: Buttons, nav links and "›" links share one 15px/500 size, so every pressable thing reads as the same kind of thing.

rules.name: The All-in-View Rule
rules.body: Nothing scrolls sideways. Rows that do not fit wrap into a grid, the family strip becomes five equal cells, and gallery thumbnails wrap to a second line. There are no carousels and no hidden overflow.

rules.name: The Thumb Reach Rule
rules.body: Every control and quote link is at least 40px tall, and icon buttons, menu rows, strip items and FAQ triggers are 44 to 48px. On a product page below 768px, the quote action lives in a bar fixed to the foot of the screen, and the footer pads itself 5.5rem so the bar never covers it.

rules.name: The Impression Rule
rules.body: Shadows go inward. The only outward shadow grounds a cut-out object, and it is never put on a container.

rules.name: The Working Icon Rule
rules.body: Icons are lucide-react outlines at stroke 2 (1.75 inside discs); the WhatsApp brand mark comes from Tabler and is the only Tabler icon. They sit beside a label and help a buyer find something faster: contact routes (mail, phone, WhatsApp) in the contact bar, menu, footer, contact page and product actions; the four trust promises; the four process steps; and the attachment hint. Promises and steps set their 18px icon in a 36px aluminium circle. Inline icons are 16px (14px beside 13px contact-bar text, 20px beside the 15px WhatsApp link and on the contact page, 24px inside 44px icon buttons). Product and family cards, section headings, buyer quotes and FAQ items carry no content icons; the chevrons on links, accordions and the products disclosure are controls, not content.

rules.name: The Die Edge Rule
rules.body: Every focusable element shows a 2px ink outline offset 3px on `:focus-visible`. Inside `.on-die` the outline is Die Light. Fields add their own soft ring on top.

rules.name: The Cleared Lead Rule
rules.body: Lead spots (type cards, type heroes and "Get to know" cards) show only studio renders, cut-outs, images set on that type or card in Sanity, or catalog photos on the `LEAD_PHOTOS` allowlist that are at least 1000px wide. Catalog photos that carry a client's mark never lead. They stay in the style grids.

dos: **Do** write layouts for phones first, then widen at sm 640, md 768, lg 1024 and xl 1280.
**Do** show every item at once in a wrapping grid, 12px apart on phones and 16px from md.
**Do** space sections at 2.5rem, 3.5rem from md and 4rem from lg, and drop the top padding of a second same-ground section.
**Do** keep every control and quote link at least 40px tall, and icon buttons 44px.
**Do** spend plum only on the quote pill and text links. On the die band, use the light pill.
**Do** open sections with the Section Intro and inner pages with the Page Header, using the scale utilities.
**Do** put a 16px outline icon beside contact routes, and an 18px icon in a 36px aluminium disc beside promises and steps.
**Do** express state as impressions: 1px deboss on press and a 2px ink ring offset 3px on focus. Mark the current page with full ink.
**Do** carry the product name into every quote action that has one.
**Do** ship a `.webp.json` provenance sidecar beside every new raster.
**Do** close every style grid and family grid on the "Not in the catalog?" tile.
donts: **Don't** build rows that scroll sideways, or carousels of any kind.
**Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker, overline or numbered tag above a heading.
**Don't** put icons on product or family cards, section headings, buyer quotes or FAQ items.
**Don't** add borders or drop shadows to cards. The only outward shadow grounds a cut-out object.
**Don't** add a second authored motion, timed carousels or fade-in reveals. The strike never starts from opacity 0.
**Don't** use off-palette greys or reds (Tailwind slate, gray or red scales). Use the named tokens.
**Don't** add one-off type sizes or clamps outside the ramp.
**Don't** use more than one die band on a page.
